101212200022210211100120 - ASI: 19

Rules:
  10 = 1 * 0
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  022 = 0 * 22
  100 = 10 * 0
  101 = 10 * 1
  120 = 1 * 20
  200 = 20 * 0
  210 = 2 * 10
  211 = 21 * 1
  212 = 21 * 2
  100120 = 100 * 120
  101212 = 101 * 212
  200022 = 200 * 022
  210211 = 210 * 211
  101212200022 = 101212 * 200022
  210211100120 = 210211 * 100120
  101212200022210211100120 = 101212200022 * 210211100120
